title: Engaging Social Media Influencers for Government Campaigns
what_it_is: Engaging Social Media Influencers for Government Campaigns

sections.label: Social media influencer engagement budget
sections.summary: The Minister states influencers are one communications channel, may be engaged to complement efforts, and campaigns are evaluated without solely tracking influencers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information (a) whether the Ministry has a budget for engaging social media influencers; (b) if so, how much is the budget; (c) what are the contents that influencers are engaged to publicise; and (d) how will the success of influencer campaigns be measured.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Social media influencers are just one of the channels used to communicate to Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Influencers may be engaged if they can complement our broader communications efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: We evaluate the effectiveness of our public communications campaigns, but we do not solely track how influencers fare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: First, will the influencers engaged by the Government be required to declare, openly and clearly, within their posts, which agency is sponsoring their posts?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Specifically, will this fall under the definition of "published by" or "on the candidate's behalf"?

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I told the House that the influencer that he mentioned has also put the "sponsorship" or "paid by" logo.

sections.label: Giam file with right Ministry
sections.summary: The speaker proposes that Mr Giam file it with the right Ministry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: My proposal is for Mr Giam to file it with the right Ministry.
